description: One poa1 address's wallet binding, public data only: linked (true or false from minepoa's /api/links, null before POAScan's first read), vault (the vault publicId), family_size and family (addresses linked to the same vault: one entity, one jury seat, one vote), chains (each external address in its chains map with minepoa's verified flag), identity_link_txs and chains_update_txs (id, ts unix seconds, final; newest first), joined_ts, warning ({kind: joined_no_link, hours, text} when it joined in the last 72 h without a link, else null), links_checked_at, links_stale and lookup_url (https://poascan.io/wallet?address=<address>, the shareable Check my wallet page). A link is needed only to swap. Use it to check whether an Agent is ready to swap or to verify an external address; never ask anyone for keys. Never send payment outside the network.
